formula: SiblingNegotiation ~ FoodTreatment * SexParent + ArrivalTime + offset(log(BroodSize)) + (1 | Nest)
notes: Zuur Mixed (2009) ch.5 & ch.13: Poisson GLMM of barn-owl sibling negotiation, offset log(BroodSize), random nest. NegPerChick is the per-chick alternate response; BroodSize is the offset (ignored, used in formula).

formula: Richness ~ NAP * Exposure + (1 | Beach)
notes: Zuur Mixed (2009) ch.5: the canonical RIKZ mixed model, species richness by NAP and Exposure over 9 beaches, random intercept (random-slope 1+NAP|Beach also fitted). Richness is a species count (type follows the column, book fits Gaussian). Exposure a factor. Sample is a row id.

formula: Ecervi ~ Length * Sex + (1 | Farm)
notes: Zuur Mixed (2009) ch.13: Bernoulli GLMM of E. cervi presence (Ecervi>0) by length and sex, random farm. True family Bernoulli; the dichotomised presence is not a column, so the raw intensity Ecervi is filed continuous (fifeschool precedent). Sex (1/2) a factor.

formula: Prevalence ~ Length + Depth + Sex + Stage + Age + Year + (1 | Area)
notes: Zuur Mixed (2009) ch.13: binomial GLMM of cod parasite presence/absence with a random effect on Area (and Year). Intensity is the count alternate response (NB / zero-inflated elsewhere in the book), ignored; Sample a row id. Design clear, exact random term recalled approximately -> medium.

formula: 15N ~ Age + (1 | Tooth)
notes: Zuur Mixed (2009): nitrogen isotope ratio along whale teeth, additive mixed / GAMM with a smoother of Age and a random tooth effect (several teeth, repeated along age). Rendered as a random-intercept approximation -> medium.

formula: IntakeRate ~ Sex + AGE + Bplumage + Period + (1 | ID)
notes: Zuur Mixed (2009): godwit (Limosa) foraging intake rate, repeated observations per bird (ID), linear mixed model. RECORD is a row id. Sex/Period factors.

formula: Spobee ~ Infection + BeesN + (1 | Hive)
notes: Zuur Mixed (2009) ch.4: American foulbrood spore density per bee, three measurements per hive (random hive / variance structure). Rawdata is the raw count Spobee is scaled from; X,Y are hive coordinates. Infection a factor.

formula: Concentration ~ Treatment * Nutrient + Biomass + (1 | Mesocosm)
notes: Zuur Mixed (2009): benthic biodiversity experiment, dissolved-nutrient concentration explained by algae treatment and nutrient type, three replicate measurements per mesocosm (random mesocosm). MU duplicates Mesocosm. Abundance an alternate response. Treatment/Nutrient factors.

formula: Sources ~ SampleDepth + BottomDepth + Season + (1 | Station)
notes: Zuur Mixed (2009): deep-sea pelagic bioluminescence (number of light sources) vs sample depth, measurements nested within station (random station / GAMM smoother by station). Lat/Long/Xkm/Ykm coordinates ignored; Discovery is the cruise id.

formula: Abun ~ WeekTime + Timeofday + Windspeed + Weather + (1 | Site)
notes: Zuur Mixed (2009): harbour-seal haul-out counts repeated over weeks within site, Poisson additive mixed model with random site. countsBK1.txt is an identical copy (excluded).

formula: Richness ~ ROCK + LITTER + BARESOIL + FallPrec + SprTmax + Time + (1 | Transect)
notes: Zuur Mixed (2009): plant species richness in transects sampled repeatedly over years (random transect), linear/additive mixed model. SAMPLEYR is the calendar year, Time the within-transect sampling index.

formula: LNAFD ~ LNLENGTH + (1 | MONTH)
notes: Zuur Mixed (2009) ch.4: log ash-free dry weight vs log length. RULE GAP: the book fits a fixed MONTH factor with month-specific residual variance (gls heterogeneity), no random effect; MONTH (12 months of repeated measurements) rendered as (1|MONTH) under the #24 repeating-cluster rule, at low. AFD/LENGTH are the raw columns of LNAFD/LNLENGTH.

formula: Testisweight ~ DML + (1 | MONTH)
notes: Zuur Mixed (2009) ch.4: squid testis weight vs mantle length. RULE GAP: a gls heterogeneity example (month-specific variance, varPower), MONTH a fixed factor; rendered (1|MONTH) per the #24 repeating-cluster rule, at low. Specimen a row id. squidmales.txt is an identical copy (excluded).

formula: Age ~ Sex + Stain + (1 | Species) + (1 | DolphinID)
notes: Zuur Mixed (2009) ch.5 nested-data example: cetacean teeth, three stain readings per dolphin, dolphins within species. RESPONSE and random structure inferred from the columns (Age the measured variable, Stain the method); low.

formula: presence ~ pprim_ssite + psec_ssite + phss_1km + pm_1km + pdens_1km + edens_1km + rdens_1km + (1 | site)
notes: Zuur GLMM example: koala presence/absence over subsites nested in site (random site), binomial GLMM of habitat covariates. Covariates reduced to the 1km-scale habitat metrics; the 5km/2.5km scales, subsite id and easting/northing coordinates are ignored. Exact covariate set inferred -> low.

formula: AQBIRDS ~ SPTREAT + DEPTH + AREA + Time + (1 | FIELD)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: waterbird use of rice fields under straw treatments, fields repeated over time within site. Aggregate aquatic-bird density (AQBIRDS) taken as the response; the ~50 per-species density columns and the other aggregates are alternate responses in ignore. Field nested in site. low. SITE holds one level (4mile) in the loaded table, so FIELD is the only grouping factor; SITE ignored (merge refusal, corrected 2026-10-08).

formula: CHLFa ~ SAL + T + DIN + DIP + SIL + TN + TP + Month + (1 | Station)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: Dutch coastal monitoring series, repeated monthly measurements per station. Chlorophyll-a (CHLFa) taken as the response explained by salinity, temperature and nutrients, random station. 31UE_ED50/31UN_ED50 are coordinates. low.

formula: N_days ~ Species + Size_cm + PDayRain + Tot_Rain + Temp_avg + Season + (1 | Road)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED / RULE GAP: snake road-mortality records, several snakes per road. N_days (carcass persistence) taken as the response vs rain/temperature/size; Road the spatial cluster per the #24 repeating-cluster rule. Response and grouping inferred -> low.

formula: wt ~ wingcrd + flatwing + tarsus + head + culmen + nalospi + Sex + Age + (1 | observer)
notes: RULE GAP: sparrow morphometrics; the book fits OLS regression of weight on size, no random effect. observer (each observer measured many birds) rendered as the measurement cluster (1|observer) per the #24 repeating-cluster rule, at low. SexNew derived from Sex; Speciescode near-constant.

formula: Nauplii ~ Volume + Depth + Production_week + Month + (1 | Station)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: plankton (sea-lice larvae) sampled at stations (A/C/E) and depths over time. Nauplii count taken as the response; Copepod is the other life-stage alternate response. Station the repeated cluster. low.

formula: Signs_in_yard ~ Accessible_feed_present + Accessible_feed_store_present + Accessible_cattle_house_present + No_cattle_in_buidlings_yard + Season + (1 | farm_code_numeric)
notes: RULE GAP: repeated badger-activity surveys within farms over seasons. Signs_in_yard (presence) taken as the binomial response vs farm feed/accessibility, random farm. The many latrine/sett count columns ignored; Survey is the within-farm index. BadgersFarmSurveysNoNA is the NA-removed subset (excluded). Exact model inferred -> low.

formula: Hsimilis ~ Level + MedSand + (1 | Location)
notes: Zuur Beginner's Guide to GLM/GLMM (2013): polychaete (Hediste) counts by intertidal level and median sand grain size, samples grouped by Location (beach), Poisson/NB GLMM with random location. Level a factor.

formula: Richness ~ Hlog10 + Treespecies + Sitetype + Ageclass + GroundVeg + HerbLayer + ShrubLayer + MeanLitterDepth + (1 | Plot)
notes: Zuur Beginner's Guide to GLM/GLMM (2013): spider species richness vs habitat heterogeneity (Hlog10) and microhabitat, quadrats within plot (random plot). TotalAbundance / ForestRichness / OpenRichness are alternate responses; X,Y coordinates; ID a row id. Exact covariate subset -> medium.

formula: PA ~ CellSize + (1 | Hive)
notes: Zuur Beginner's Guide to GLM/GLMM (2013): worker-bee parasite presence/absence vs comb cell size, bees grouped by hive (random hive), binomial GLMM.

formula: cbind(Number, Scans - Number) ~ Size + Visual + Raised + Visitors + Feeding + Enrichment + Group + Sex + Diet + Age + (1 | Zoo)
notes: Zuur Beginner's Guide to GLM/GLMM (2013): stereotypic-behaviour scans (Number out of Scans) for zoo animals grouped by Zoo (random zoo), binomial GLMM. Proportion = Number/Scans (alternate); Eps a row id.

formula: Dandelion ~ Treatment + Time + (1 | Hive)
notes: Zuur Beginner's Guide to GLM/GLMM (2013): dandelion pollen collected by honeybee hives over four times, repeated measures per hive (random hive). Exact model inferred -> low; Unnamed: 4 is an empty column.

formula: leaves ~ crown.mm + diam.1 + diam.2 + Year + (1 | Genus) + (1 | Genus:Species)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: tropical tree-seedling measurements, seedlings within species within genus. Leaf count taken as the response vs crown/diameter; biomass and leaf-area columns are alternate responses; Identifier a row id; Unnamed: 12/13 empty. low.

formula: Beaver ~ Petiole_Diameter + Mid_line_Distance + (1 | Site)
notes: Zuur Zero-Inflated Models (2016): whether a plant was browsed by beaver (Y/N) vs petiole diameter and distance, observations grouped by Site (= Year:Loch). Loch is the component, Year the component.

formula: NEggs ~ NLowBranches + TreeHeight + HerbCover + Shelter + BuckthornAbundance + BrambleAbundance + SmallOakAbundance + Distance2Edge + NearestTallOak + (1 | Area)
notes: RULE GAP: butterfly eggs per oak (zero-inflated count) vs tree/habitat covariates. The ZIP example in the book may carry no random effect; Area (oaks grouped within study area) rendered as (1|Area) per the #24 repeating-cluster rule, at low. OakNr a row id; X,Y coordinates.

formula: final.Triadica.abundance ~ window.duration + stress.type + competition + fertilization + (1 | replicate)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED / RULE GAP: Chinese tallow tree (Triadica) stress-competition-fertilization experiment. Final seedling abundance taken as the zero-inflated count response; replicate (1-8) rendered as a randomized-block grouping, uncertain whether it is a shared block. Pre-stress / delta / biomass columns ignored. low.

formula: BMS10mg ~ OriginAltitude + GardenAltitude + InitSize + Soil + (1 | Location) + (1 | Garden) + (1 | Garden:Bed)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: Frei et al. 2014 transplant experiment, plants from origin Locations grown in Gardens and Beds. Shoot biomass (BMS10mg) taken as the response; Location (origin), Garden and Bed (within garden) as crossed/nested random effects. Other biomass/phenology columns are alternate responses; Nr/ID ids. low.

formula: Kiwi ~ Treatment + Time + (1 | Hive)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: honeybee pollen collection over four times per hive (as in pollen.txt). Kiwi pollen count taken as the response vs treatment and time, random hive; the other colour counts and TotalWeight are alternate responses. low.

formula: NumFledged ~ BreedingDensity + Precip + (1 | Year)
notes: RULE GAP: orange-crowned warbler reproductive success (fledglings, zero-inflated count) vs breeding density and precipitation, nests grouped by Year. Few years makes the random year weak; kept at low per the repeating-cluster rule. Xloc/Yloc coordinates; band/nest ids ignored.

formula: THICK ~ PCB + DDE + DDD + (1 | COAST)
notes: RULE GAP: osprey eggshell thickness vs organochlorine contaminants. COAST (Atlantic / Maurice / Delaware, 3 levels) rendered as a site cluster (1|COAST) per the #24 repeating-cluster rule; could instead be a region covariate. 25 rows, low.

formula: Coverage ~ Exposure + Rainfall + Riverflow + Temperature + Month + (1 | Location) + (1 | Location:Site) + (1 | Location:Site:Transect)
notes: Zuur Zero-Inflated Models (2016): seagrass percentage cover (zero-inflated) in quadrats nested within transect within site within location, environmental covariates. Quadrat the observation unit; Date/Day/Year ignored.

formula: Draconarius ~ Blattodea_dw + Orthoptera_dw + Ti_dw + SoilMoisture + LogLeaf + Distance + Season + (1 | Site)
notes: Zuur Zero-Inflated Models (2016): Hong Kong spider (Draconarius) counts (zero-inflated) vs prey dry weights and leaf litter, quadrats within site (random site). Other spider species (Pardosa, Heteropoda) and the prey count columns are alternate responses; Leaf is the raw of LogLeaf. medium.

formula: Totalparasites ~ LT + LS + Weight + SEX + (1 | Location)
notes: Zuur Zero-Inflated Models (2016): fish total parasite load (negative-binomial / zero-inflated count) vs length, weight and sex, fish grouped by Location (random location). ID a row id; SEX a factor.
